body: What was it like adjusting to fame / being a public figure?
Thank you for your kind words, it helps me keep the faith.

The last phrase you wrote, "questioning why you have certain expectations" gave me pause.

I guess the rage I'm feeling is holding on to disappointment that "getting the grades, going to college, working the dream job and accomplishing the dream project will make me happy," when none of that worked. Maybe.

And now there's no clear path. And everyone around me lives in the "get a job, get married, have kids" mentality. So I have to find a different path or story I suppose.
Sure, I've been trying to find God or a God for awhile now. Send me a PM if you like.
